correctness.rationale: Exact discrete-jump decomposition reduces the full operator seminorm to three computable responses. Verified natural-cubic curvature system has positive determinant; all segment extrema and signs are accounted for, including the middle-step monotonicity and the outer-step middle hump. The derived inequality proves strict increase of the outer branch; central branch decreases strictly; endpoint limits and continuity give the unique minimax crossing. A standalone exact rational interval and finite critical-point checker replayed successfully; sampling is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is the first symmetric four-knot natural cubic case with two coupled curvature unknowns and competing central/outer jump instabilities. The complete all-positive-middle-spacing solution identifies a unique nonuniform optimal design and reduces sharp variation amplification by about 13.15 percent compared with equal spacing. The precise optimizer is a motivated stability-design invariant, not an arbitrary isolated sample. The qualitative minimizer differs from both global cubic Lagrange interpolation and infinite cardinal cubic spline interpolation.
